title: Audit-event divergence: reconcile RBACv2 changefeed & SAML session trail
creator: Nina Patel
description: Summary: During the staggered rollout of RBAC v2, we observed a divergence between the RBAC changefeed (operator -> audit pipeline) and SAML/SSO session logs. Some admin role changes were not present in the primary audit index for a 3-hour window, while SAML sessions show duplicated session IDs that complicate user mapping. Impact: delayed detection of privilege escalations and noisy alerts in the security dashboard. Goal: identify root causes, create deterministic reconciliation between changefeed and auth session trail, tighten SLOs/alerts, and land automation to prevent recurrence. Scope: generator and ingestion path for RBAC changefeed, change-transforms, audit-indexer, SAML session collector, alerts and dashboards. Hypotheses: 1) changefeed batching + backpressure caused out-of-order commits to audit index; 2) SAML session re-issue logic created duplicate session IDs across identity providers when retries occurred; 3) indexer dedup logic misclassified admin role-change events as non-admin. Approach: reproduce in staging with synthetic RBAC write bursts and SAML retry scenarios; instrument changefeed commits and indexer trace ids; add end-to-end test asserting event monotonicity; add temporary alert to detect mismatch rate >0.5% per hour; implement a reconciler job that backfills missing events and flags corrective actions. Acceptance criteria: reproducible test that fails with current code, PRs merged to fix transform or indexer, reconciler scheduled weekly, and dashboard shows mismatch rate <0.02% for 7 consecutive days.
comments: 2025-02-18 - Triage: on-call found missing audit entries for a subset of admin role-change events after RBACv2 toggle to new pipeline. Pager duty triggered, SLO for audit completeness breached for 3 hours. Assigned to Marco for immediate investigation.

2025-02-19 - Initial findings: indexer logs show repeated transient 502s to the storage cluster during peak batch flushes. Changefeed retries were coalescing events; dedup bucket timing may have suppressed admin flag. Added temporary metric 'audit.changefeed.commit_latency' to Grafana.

2025-02-21 - Repro run: synthetic workload in staging reproduced missing events when changefeed flush and indexer outage overlapped. SAML session duplicate observed when IdP responded with 202 then 200 on retry; session generator didn't regenerate a new trace id. Patch created to add idempotency key to SAML session collection flow. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/audit-indexer/pull/412 (in review).

2025-02-24 - Mitigation deployed: indexer retry backoff tuned, temporary queue increased to 2x to reduce backpressure. Alert rule added: 'auth.audit.mismatch_rate' fires if divergence >0.5% for 30m. Noted trade-off: larger queue increases memory pressure on indexer pods; monitoring in place.

2025-02-27 - Post-deploy observation: mismatch rate dropped to 0.12% but still above target. Decided to implement reconciler job to backfill missed role-change events and to harden dedup logic around admin attribute. Owner: SRE (Asha Rao) + Eng (Marco Reyes).

2025-03-01 - Next steps: finish indexer PR fixes, land SAML idempotency patch, add end-to-end test to infra repo, and schedule the reconciler run for 2025-03-05. Add runbook section for audit divergence incidents and update incident playbook with checklists and escalation steps.
